name: joins
title: Large-volume joins
summary: Revenue per country: orders ⋈ customers, then group-by
description: A primary-key / foreign-key join between a large fact table (orders, from several sources) and a dimension table (customers), followed by a group-by on country. 3 % of orders reference unknown customers and are dropped by the inner join.

variants.name: hash
variants.label: Hash join
variants.description: Build an open-addressing hash table on customers, probe it with every order.

variants.name: sort_merge
variants.label: Sort-merge join
variants.description: Sort both inputs on customer_id, then merge the sorted runs.

name: text_search
title: Text search
description: Boolean keyword search (one or two terms joined by AND) over a corpus of support tickets with a Zipf-distributed vocabulary. Queries mix common, mid-frequency and rare terms; every variant returns the exact same sorted document lists.

variants.name: regex_scan
variants.label: Full scan (regex)
variants.description: Scan the whole corpus with a compiled word-boundary regex for each query term.

variants.name: inverted_index
variants.label: Inverted index
variants.description: Tokenise once, build term → posting lists, answer queries by intersection.

name: streaming
title: Streaming aggregation
summary: Sliding-window counts, sums and distinct users
description: One day of time-ordered sensor/click events aggregated into 5-minute windows that slide every minute, per region: event count, value sum and distinct users. Exact variants must return identical results; approximate ones are scored on their error.

variants.name: batch_recompute
variants.label: Batch recompute
variants.description: Recompute each window from scratch: every event is aggregated 5 times.

variants.name: incremental
variants.label: Incremental panes
variants.description: Per-minute partials; add the entering pane, retract the leaving one.

variants.name: approx_hll
variants.label: Incremental + HyperLogLog
variants.description: Exact counts and sums; distinct users from mergeable HLL sketches (p=10).

variants.name: approx_sampling
variants.label: 10 % user sample
variants.description: Aggregate a consistent 10 % sample of users and scale every metric by 10.

name: indexing
title: Indexing
summary: Point and range lookups on a key-value table
description: A key-value table with unique 64-bit keys answers a batch of point lookups (80 % of keys exist) and range queries. The build phase (creating the index) and the query phase are measured separately to expose the build-cost versus query-cost trade-off.

variants.name: scan
variants.label: No index (full scan)
variants.description: Answer every query by scanning all keys.

variants.name: btree
variants.label: B+-tree
variants.description: Bulk-load a B+-tree (fanout 64); descend it for each query.

variants.name: hash_index
variants.label: Hash index
variants.description: Open-addressing hash table on the key; ranges fall back to scans.
